attackPower.description: How much damage this collectible deals when used as a weapon.

attackRange.description: The maximum distance an entity can be for you to attack it with this object.

behaviors.description: Modifiers that can alter the behavior of the item or block, mostly for held interactions

creativeInventory.description: A list of creative tabs and variant codes for each

creativeInventoryStacks.description: A list of specific item stacks to place in specific creative tabs

damagedBy.description: From which damage sources does the item takes durability damage.

durability.description: How many uses does this collectible has when being used. Item disappears at durability 0

heldLeftReadyAnimation.description: The animation to play in 3rd person when returning to idle from use in the left hand.

heldLeftTpIdleAnimation.description: The animation to play in 3rd person mode when holding this collectible in the left hand

heldRightReadyAnimation.description: The animation to play in 3rd person when returning to idle from use in the right hand.

heldRightTpIdleAnimation.description: The animation to play in 3rd person mode when holding this collectible in the right hand

heldTpHitAnimation.description: The animation to play in 3rd person mode when hitting with this collectible

heldTpUseAnimation.description: The animation to play in 3rd person mod when using this collectible

lightHsv.description: For light emitting collectibles: hue, saturation and brightness value. See also http://tyron.at/vs/vslightwheel.html for all possible values.

liquidSelectable.description: When this item is held, can the player select liquids?

materialDensity.description: Determines on whether an object floats on liquids or not. Water has a density of 1000

maxStackSize.description: Max amount of collectible that one default inventory slot can hold

miningSpeed.description: Modifies how fast the player can break a block when holding this item

particleProperties.description: Particles that should spawn in regular intervals from this block or item when held in hands

renderAlphaTest.description: Alpha test value for rendering in gui, fp hand, tp hand or on the ground

storageFlags.description: Determines in which kind of bags the item can be stored in.

tool.description: If set, this item will be classified as given tool

toolTier.description: The object can mine any blocks with the same or lower tier than this. If this object is a weapon, this also determines the object's damage tier.

transitionableProps.description: Information about the transitionable states - Should this collectible turn into another item after a period of time?

transitionablePropsByType.description: Information about the transitionable states - Should this collectible turn into another item after a period of time?
